episodes.title: Where it starts
episodes.brief: Episode 1. Dawn in our family orange orchard in Antalya. Every winter the whole valley smells like oranges and spice; that smell is what we send to customers. Introduce the series.
episodes.gemini_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic video, 8 seconds, photorealistic. Golden sunrise in a Mediterranean orange orchard on the hills of Antalya, Turkey, the sea glowing softly in the distance. Close-up: a man's weathered hands gently twist a ripe, dew-covered orange from its branch and place it in a woven basket full of oranges. Slow dolly-in, soft lens flare, shallow depth of field, light breeze moving the leaves. Sound: birdsong, leaves rustling, soft acoustic guitar. A warm, friendly female voice-over in American English says: "This is our family's orange orchard in Antalya. Every winter, it smells like Christmas. So we decided to send it to you." No on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions.

episodes.title: My uncle's spice shop
episodes.brief: Episode 2. The cinnamon sticks, cloves and star anise come from my uncle's wholesale spice shop in Eminonu, Istanbul's historic spice bazaar.
episodes.gemini_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic video, 8 seconds, photorealistic. Inside a small, old wholesale spice shop in Istanbul's Eminonu spice bazaar: burlap sacks overflowing with cinnamon sticks, star anise and cloves, warm hanging lamps, wooden shelves with glass jars. Close-up: an older man's hands scoop star anise with a brass scoop onto an old brass scale; dust of spice glows in a beam of light. Slow handheld push-in, shallow depth of field. Sound: soft bazaar murmur in the background, the clink of the brass scoop, gentle acoustic guitar continuing the same melody. A warm female voice-over in American English says: "The cinnamon and star anise come from my uncle's spice shop, in Istanbul's old spice bazaar." No on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions.

episodes.title: In her kitchen
episodes.brief: Episode 3. The finished kit arrives in a cozy American kitchen in winter: pour the pouch into a pot of water and let it simmer; a bulk gift of 12 pouches for teachers, neighbors and friends.
episodes.gemini_prompt: Vertical 9:16 cinematic video, 8 seconds, photorealistic. A cozy American farmhouse kitchen on a snowy winter morning, snow falling outside the window, Christmas lights softly blurred. A woman in a cream knit sweater opens a kraft paper stand-up pouch with a clear window showing dried orange slices, cinnamon sticks and star anise, and a cream label with a small watercolor orange illustration, and pours it into a white enamel pot of water on the stove. Steam begins to rise; she closes her eyes and smiles as the scent fills the room. Slow push-in, warm golden light, shallow depth of field. Sound: gentle simmering, soft acoustic guitar. A warm female voice-over in American English says: "Just add water and let it simmer. Twelve little pouches, one for everyone on your list." No on-screen text, no subtitles, no captions.

episodes.title: Sun-dried by hand
episodes.brief: Episode 4. We slice our oranges thin by hand and dry them on wooden racks in the Mediterranean sun.

episodes.title: Packed in Istanbul
episodes.brief: Episode 5. Every kraft pouch is blended and packed by hand in our Istanbul workshop.

episodes.title: Your name on it
episodes.brief: Episode 6. Personalized labels: a teacher's name, a company logo or a wedding couple's names on every pouch.

episodes.title: For the teacher
episodes.brief: Episode 7. A teacher opens a pouch with her name on the label from her class; the smell of oranges and cinnamon fills the classroom.

episodes.title: For the whole office
episodes.brief: Episode 8. Twelve pouches on an office table before the holiday party; coworker and client gifts that feel personal.

episodes.title: For the wedding guests
episodes.brief: Episode 9. Winter wedding favors: pouches on every guest's place card with the couple's names.

episodes.title: Forty years
episodes.brief: Episode 10. An elderly man smells the simmering pot and remembers his mother's kitchen at Christmas, forty years ago. Part 1 of a two-part story.

episodes.title: From Istanbul to your porch
episodes.brief: Episode 11. The journey: pouches boxed in Istanbul, shipped, and arriving on a snowy front porch.

episodes.title: The hostess gift
episodes.brief: Episode 12. A guest arrives at a holiday dinner with a pouch; the host puts it on the stove and the house fills with the scent.

episodes.title: Forty years, part 2
episodes.brief: Episode 13. Part 2: the elderly man shares the simmer pot with his grandchildren; the tradition continues.
